current_activity: The 361st VG Division holds the Marne-Rhin Canal to Moyenvic sector on the eve of the Third Army attack
notes: Event date: CMH Lorraine Campaign ch. 7 p. 312: "the 361st VG Division, assigned to the LXXXIX Corps, disposed in the sector from the Marne-Rhin Canal up to a point just west of Moyenvic"; p. 313: "the 361st VG Division had a battalion in reserve near Dieuze". Event definition: the eve of the XII Corps attack, which began on 8 November; CMH gives no day for the disposition. Event support: one source family (CMH). Location: Moyenvic with a precision of 10 km, the western end of the sector. Location approximate: a town point at the end of the sector. Location support: CMH names the canal and Moyenvic. Commander: Colonel Alfred Philippi. Opponents: US XII Corps (35th and 26th Infantry Divisions). Context: The day of the disposition is approximate: CMH writes "on the eve of the American offensive".
